name: Poly Cubed at Pomona 2026
information:
The incredible sequel to 2025's hit competition, Poly^3 @ Pomona 2026 will have more competitors, more cubes, and more popular events!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyCubedatPomona2026#68012-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
